question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?
sql:
WITH ordered_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as row_num
    FROM activity_log
),
detail_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        row_num,
        path
    FROM ordered_visits
    WHERE path = '/detail'
),
consecutive_detail AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.session,
        d1.row_num as first_detail_row,
        d2.row_num as second_detail_row
    FROM detail_visits d1
    JOIN detail_visits d2 ON d1.session = d2.session AND d2.row_num = d1.row_num + 1
),
third_page AS (
    SELECT 
        c.session,
        c.first_detail_row,
        c.second_detail_row,
        o.path as third_page_path
    FROM consecutive_detail c
    JOIN ordered_visits o ON c.session = o.session AND o.row_num = c.second_detail_row + 1
)
SELECT 
    third_page_path,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM third_page
GROUP BY third_page_path
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 3

{"sql": "WITH ordered_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as row_num
    FROM activity_log
),
detail_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        row_num,
        path
    FROM ordered_visits
    WHERE path = '/detail'
),
consecutive_detail AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.session,
        d1.row_num as first_detail_row,
        d2.row_num as second_detail_row
    FROM detail_visits d1
    JOIN detail_visits d2 ON d1.session = d2.session AND d2.row_num = d1.row_num + 1
)
SELECT 
    c.session,
    c.first_detail_row,
    c.second_detail_row,
    o.path as third_page_path
FROM consecutive_detail c
JOIN ordered_visits o ON c.session = o.session AND o.row_num = c.second_detail_row + 1
ORDER BY c.session, c.first_detail_row
LIMIT 20", "preview_rows": 20}
